notes.title: Workshop beta now open to all!
notes.content:
Players of PiB can now go test out the new Workshop features:
- Paint your own paintings and share with the community
- Play paintings created by the community.

There's a bunch of paintings up there already, just waiting to be played!

More details and how to join the beta can be found [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/385250/discussions/0/365163686082721758/]here[/url].

notes.title: PiB 2.0.4 is Up, and something in the future?
notes.content:
New version is up with:

- A shortcut for Marks mode that can be remapped.  Defaults to M key.
- Added XInput.  Should fix a bug on Win 7 when using XBox One Wireless.
- Moved the tutorial on/off toggle to a more noticeable place.

Also - I've been working on a Level Editor, which for PiB is a thing you can use to paint pictures/puzzles.  I'm hoping to get this going with Workshop so that everybody can create and share their own paintings.  Can't say when it'll get done as it's not the only thing I'm working on, but it's in the works!
